Basic chat completion via the AWS Bedrock provider using the bedrock/ prefix for routing — verifies the prefix is stripped before dispatching and the Converse API response is normalised to the standard OpenAI chat completion shape

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "liter_llm"
result = LiterLlm.chat(LiterLlm::ChatCompletionRequest.new(max_tokens: 16, messages: [{ 'content' => 'Say hello in one word.', 'role' => 'user' }], model: 'bedrock/anthropic.claude-3-sonnet-20240229-v1:0', temperature: 0))
puts result.inspect
```
